config.cooking-balancing.name: Cooking Balance
config.cooking-balancing.tooltip: Ensure cooking dishes always sell for at least the configured profit margin over raw ingredients.
config.cooking-margin.name: Cooking Margin
config.food-quality.name: Food Star Levels
config.food-quality.tooltip: Enables cooked dishes to inherit quality (Silver, Gold, Iridium) from ingredients and enhanced Qi Seasoning.
config.quality-priority.name: Ingredient Priority
config.quality-priority.tooltip: Which ingredients to consume first when cooking.
config.enhanced-buffs.name: Enhanced Food Buffs
config.enhanced-buffs.tooltip: Grants +2 to active stat buffs for Iridium meals and scales buff duration.
config.iridium-buff-duration.name: Iridium Buff Duration
config.iridium-buff-duration.tooltip: Duration multiplier for Iridium-quality meals and drinks (default 2.0x).
config.mead-fix.name: Mead Flavor & Value Fix
config.mead-fix.tooltip: Mead preserves the underlying flower type and scales to a balanced multiplier of flower honey value.
config.flower-mead-multiplier.name: Flower Mead Multiplier
config.flower-mead-multiplier.tooltip: Price multiplier for Flower Honey Mead relative to flower honey base value (default: 1.35x).
config.machine-quality.name: Artisan Machine Star Matrix
config.machine-quality.tooltip: Enables the balanced 60/25/15 quality matrix (Normal, Silver, Gold, 0% Iridium) for artisan machines (Keg, Preserves Jar, Cheese Press, Mayo Machine, Loom, Oil Maker, Dehydrator, Smoker).
config.quality-preserving.name: Quality-Preserving Machines
config.quality-preserving.tooltip: Artisan machines preserve the input item's star quality through the balanced 60/25/15 quality matrix.
config.truffle-oil-fix.name: Truffle Oil Scaling Fix
config.truffle-oil-fix.tooltip: Truffle Oil base price scales to 937g (1.5x base truffle) and inherits star qualities up to 1,967g Gold Artisan.
config.truffle-oil-multiplier.name: Truffle Oil Multiplier
config.truffle-oil-multiplier.tooltip: Price multiplier for Truffle Oil relative to base raw Truffle value (default 1.5x).
config.cooking-oil-artisan-category.name: Artisan Category for Cooking Oil
config.cooking-oil-artisan-category.tool: Assigns the Artisan Goods category (-26) to Cooking Oil so it benefits from the +40% Artisan profession bonus.
config.juice-buff.name: Vegetable Juice Buff
config.juice-buff.tooltip: Increases the selling price multiplier for Vegetable Juice brewed in Kegs.
config.juice-multiplier.name: Juice Multiplier
config.juice-multiplier.tooltip: Price multiplier for Vegetable Juice relative to raw vegetable price (default 2.75x, vanilla 2.25x).
config.expanded-aging.name: Expanded Cask Aging
config.expanded-aging.tooltip: Allows Casks to age additional artisan goods such as Vegetable Juice.
config.enable-fruit-tree-rebalance.name: Enable Fruit Tree Price Rebalance
config.enable-fruit-tree-rebalance.toolt: Rebalances orchard fruit prices (Peach/Pomegranate 180g, Orange/Apple 135g, Cherry 110g, Apricot 75g) to ensure positive Year-1 ROI.
config.auto-fruit-drop.name: Auto-Falling Fruit
config.auto-fruit-drop.tooltip: When a mature fruit tree holds the configured number of fruit, all of its fruit automatically falls to the ground overnight.
config.fruit-drop-threshold.name: Fruit Drop Threshold
config.fruit-drop-threshold.tooltip: Number of fruit on a tree that triggers the auto-drop (default 3, the vanilla maximum).
config.enable-mill-balancing.name: Enable Milling Price Balance
config.enable-mill-balancing.tooltip: Rebalances base sell prices for milled goods (Wheat Flour 90g, Sugar 50g, Rice 140g) to ensure viable agricultural processing.
config.enable-mill-artisan-category.name: Artisan Category for Milled Goods
config.enable-mill-artisan-category.tool: Assigns the Artisan Goods category (-26) to Wheat Flour, Sugar, and Rice so they benefit from the +40% Artisan profession bonus.
config.enable-mill-quality-matrix.name: Milling Star Quality Matrix
config.enable-mill-quality-matrix.toolti: Enables the quality preservation matrix for the Mill, allowing high-quality grains to produce Silver and Gold flour, sugar, and rice.
config.wheat-flour-base-price.name: Wheat Flour Base Price
config.wheat-flour-base-price.tooltip: Base sell price for Wheat Flour before quality and Artisan multipliers (default 90g).
config.sugar-base-price.name: Sugar Base Price
config.sugar-base-price.tooltip: Base sell price for Sugar before quality and Artisan multipliers (vanilla default 50g).
config.rice-base-price.name: Rice Base Price
config.rice-base-price.tooltip: Base sell price for Milled Rice before quality and Artisan multipliers (default 140g).
config.enable-mineral-rebalance.name: Enable Geode Mineral Rebalance
config.enable-mineral-rebalance.tooltip: Rebalances 41 geode minerals and 4 foraged minerals with modest 2-digit profit increases over Clint's 25g cracking fee.
config.enable-monster-loot-rebalance.too: Rebalances mid/late-game dungeon monster loot (Solar Essence 75g, Void Essence 90g, Squid Ink 175g, Bone Fragment 25g) while keeping early drops vanilla.
config.enable-tapper-multi-yield.name: Enable Tapper Multi-Yield
config.enable-tapper-multi-yield.tooltip: Grants Tree Tappers a chance to produce bonus stacks (2x/3x syrups) upon harvest.
config.standard-tapper-double-chance.too: Probability of harvesting 2x syrups from Standard Tappers (default: 0.35 = 35%).
config.heavy-tapper-triple-chance.name: Heavy Tapper Triple Chance
config.heavy-tapper-triple-chance.toolti: Probability of harvesting 3x syrups from Heavy Tappers (default: 0.20 = 20%, 2x is guaranteed 100%).
mod.description: Comprehensive artisan goods, milling, and cooking rebalance: Quality-preserving machines, Artisanal Milling with quality retention, Flower mead value scaling, Truffle Oil scaling fix, Expanded Casks, and profitable cooking (+25%).
